note: Task 12, checked with the real Mac player (builds/mac/Downbeat.app, content next to the .app, built-in copy in Contents/Resources/Data/StreamingAssets/default-content, last-known-good in ~/Library/Application Support/ovthemoon/Downbeat/last-known-good). Every run used --mute --no-record. Paths shorten the home folder to ~. The same decisions are tested without a player in ContentLocatorTests and ContentValidatorNativeTests, and the F5 path in ContentReloadPlayModeTests. NOT tested: Windows (the code and the build step are the same; the Windows built-in copy is Downbeat_Data/StreamingAssets/default-content, which the Windows build contains). Run H was added after the checkpoint-5 fixes (trial decode of every sound, last-known-good only once the app is ready); runs A-G were made before them with the same behaviour for those cases, and A-D and F were repeated on the rebuilt player (A: External and the last-known-good copy is made at ready; B, C: LastKnownGood; D, F: BuiltIn).
